levels.surface: عبد الله بن إبراهيم بن علي بن عبد الله بن جعفر بن أبي طالب

notes: Opens with «عنه»: the previous reports (prev1 to prev10) all open with a back reference; the nearest written chain is prev11 (report 8), which is a single route. How much of it is taken over is unclear, so «عنه» is written as it stands (back_reference), not as inherited names.
«في حديث طويل عن أبي إبراهيم عليه السلام»: the Imam is written after «عن» inside the chain, so a narrator; the saying («إني أؤخذ في هذه السنة») is his.
